backend/main.mo: Actor implementing access control, user profiles, approval workflow, and chat request management with admin caching.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of summarized frontend file descriptions covering screens, utilities, config, and deployment docs.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook detailing build, deploy, approval-gating checks, troubleshooting, and rollback steps.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules governing users, chat requests, chats, and messages with super_admin and approval checks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining OKLCH color variables and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint initializing Firebase via CDN and loading the frontend app.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: End-to-end smoke test checklist for signup, login flow, approval gating, and missing-profile handling.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling client-side routing, navigation, and screen rendering with auth guards.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Renders admin action menu for user rows, including approving, blocking, and changing roles with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Protects admin-only routes by checking Firestore user roles and redirecting unauthorized users.
frontend/src/components/auth/Authenticat: Guards routes requiring authenticated users by verifying Firebase auth and Firestore profile.
Provides a shared layout for auth-related screens with centered content and a footer.
frontend/src/components/auth/SuperAdminR: Restricts access to super-admin-only routes using Firestore role checks.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: App header showing logo, user avatar, and profile menu with navigation support.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: Dropdown profile menu offering profile navigation, admin dashboard access, and logout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity, refreshing dependent queries when updated.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: Loads Firebase modules dynamically and exposes auth state changes for the current user.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Fetches and caches the authenticated user's Firestore profile using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Fetches all Firestore users and provides mutations for approving and changing user roles.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity login state using AuthClient, exposing identity, login, logout, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and global styling.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: Wraps CDN-loaded Firebase, providing helpers for auth, Firestore access, user profile creation, first-user checks, and dynamic module loading.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase error codes to human‑readable error messages for auth and Firestore operations.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for user profiles and signup data stored in Firestore.
frontend/src/lib/postLoginRedirect.ts: Determines post-login navigation, sending unapproved users to pending approval and approved users to chat.
Client-side utility to resize and compress profile images to JPEG under 200KB and return validation metadata.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin-only screen wrapped in route guard that shows a placeholder for upcoming chat management features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Displays admin dashboard metrics by fetching user data and showing counts for total, approved, pending, and admin users with loading states.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Provides the admin layout with navigation, responsive sidebar, and main content area for all admin screens.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Renders the reports page with a placeholder card indicating analytics features are coming soon.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Shows the admin settings page with a placeholder for future configuration features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Lists all users with roles and approval status, allowing super admins to update approvals and roles.
frontend/src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx: Implements a chat UI using React Query to load chats and messages, send messages, and manage chat selection.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Displays a welcome screen and basic getting‑started cards using the logged‑in user’s profile.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Login form that authenticates with Firebase, fetches the user profile, resolves redirect logic, and handles errors.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: UI-only password reset request form that records the email locally and displays an admin-only reset notice.
frontend/src/screens/PendingApprovalScre: Displays account pending-approval status with info about admin review and option to return to login.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Loads and displays the current user’s profile details using Firestore, with fallbacks for loading and missing data.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Signup form with profile photo capture/processing, field validation, and Firebase signup submission.
frontend/src/screens/users/ApprovedUsers: Displays approved users and manages sending and handling chat requests with loading and mutation states.
frontend/src/screens/users/UserManagemen: Shows a full user list and allows toggling user approval status using Firebase mutations.
frontend/src/screens/UsersScreen.tsx: Fetches current user profile and renders the unified approved-users list, with loading and not-found states.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL and hash params, store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and persist or clear values for routing and state management.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the app’s current project state and requirements, focused on implementing a secure Firebase-based signup flow with role bootstrap and approval routing.
